# Shape iteration 0116 (#566)

## What I shaped
One task, `review-wp1-key-0115`: role `reviewer`, model `default`, effort `high`, 90 minutes / 70 turns, from main, no dependencies, inputs or exports. Graph: `.session/tasks.json`.

The reviewer is the separate cold checker for the proposed WP1 key delivered by #564 in iteration 0115 (`benchmark/writing/wp1-key-0115.{json,md}`, `check_wp1_key_0115.py`, `wp1-key-0115-verification.json`). It pins the inputs, derives its own WP1 expectation before reading the key's, gives agree/disagree/blocked per ID and per rule, checks the obligation-to-rule mapping (all not-applicable entries plus a stated sample), tests C1 grading with six hypothetical answers, and reads and runs the checker once. It reports and does not fix. Output: verdict table in its `.session/report.md` and details in `.session/artifacts/wp1-key-review-0116.json`.

## Why
- Record 0115 (`.session/history/records/0115.json`): #564 done, accepted, merged at `ae579a8`; nothing to resume.
- `benchmark/writing/wp1-key-0115.md` states independent approval is pending, lists a per-ID checklist for a separate checker, and says a disagreement blocks the ID. That check is the first item of its "Still missing" list and needs neither LabVIEW nor the owner.
- This is a new key review, not a replay of the #557 integration review. A clearance is scoped to key correctness for preparation only; it is not trial readiness, method acceptance or owner acceptance.

## Limits of this shaping
- I read the key's `.md` only. I did not read the key JSON, the checker, `method.json` or the original, and ran nothing. The task therefore tells the reviewer to take ID and rule lists from the JSON itself and asserts no counts.
- The task's `## Verification` (`python3 -I benchmark/writing/check_wp1_key_0115.py`) only confirms the reviewed package is intact; the engine cannot read the reviewer's artifact.
- No session can run LabVIEW; the task says so. Owner request #532 stays pending and blocks nothing.

## Discoveries
- Session #564 needed 4 attempts (`limit_hits: 4`, parked 1944 s) for 22 turns of work: `.session/history/records/0115.json`, `outcome.sessions[0]`. The cause is not in the record; I did not investigate it.

## What next
`journal/working-memory.md`, section "This iteration", holds the next step for both outcomes: on CLEAR, preserve the review artifact through a permitted writer and move to the next missing item; on findings, order a key revision limited to the named IDs/rules and a fresh check of those.
